title: users
description: User accounts (docs/features/user-accounts, D-206, UA-2/UA-27). A person belongs to exactly ONE tenant (v1: one email = one user = one tenant), so uniqueness of emailNormalized is GLOBAL (unique index { emailNormalized: 1 }), not per tenant. emailNormalized is the output of the UA-2 normaliser (trim, NFKC, lowercase, one '@', max 254, no control characters); the store only checks that a value is already in that form. passwordHash is a PHC string (argon2id, or the scrypt fallback), NEVER a plaintext password; the pattern rejects anything that is not '$<alg>$...'. Only status 'active' has access, and an active user always carries a role; a non-active user may carry a role (disabled keeps the previous one) or none. The tenant on a session principal comes from this row, never from a header or body.

tenantId.description: From server configuration (USER_SIGNUP_TENANT) or the bootstrap script; never from a request body.

emailNormalized.description: UA-2 normalised address; the unique key and the mail recipient.

passwordHash.description: PHC-format hash only (UA-10); parameters travel with it so it can be re-hashed later.

role.description: Set by an admin at approval (no default). Required whenever status is active.

mailStatus.description: UA failure table: when no mail could be sent the admin queue shows 'unverified (mail not sent)'.
